dct_description_sm: Appears in: Matthias Quad's Geographisch Hand Buch (1600)
German text on verso mentions the work of Leo Africanus. Also states of Da Gama's voyage and the fact that the inhabitants are black.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0020, p. 28
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0020.
